arguments.content:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked', author='Claude', initials='C', rsid='4737F9D7')

editor = doc['word/document.xml']
body = editor.dom.documentElement
paras = body.getElementsByTagName('w:p')
last_para = paras[-1]

heading = (
    '<w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading1"/></w:pPr>'
    '<w:r><w:t>Recommendations</w:t></w:r></w:p>'
)
intro = (
    '<w:p><w:r><w:t>Based on the quarterly performance, we recommend the following actions:</w:t></w:r></w:p>'
)
items = ''.join(
    f'<w:p><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="ListParagraph"/>'
    f'<w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="1"/></w:numPr></w:pPr>'
    f'<w:r><w:t>{t}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'
    for t in [
        'Increase marketing investment in high-growth regions.',
        'Accelerate the rollout of the new product line to Q3.',
        'Strengthen customer support staffing ahead of peak season.',
        'Review vendor contracts to reduce operational costs.',
    ]
)

nodes = editor.insert_after(last_para, heading + intro + items)
doc.save()
print('Recommendation section added successfully.')
